test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: If due to a 12% decrease in the price of sugar, Akshar can buy 7 kg more sugar for Rs. 1,200, then find the actual price (in Rs.) of sugar. (Rounded off to 2 decimal places)
solution:
Calculation:

Let the original price of sugar be Rs. x per kg.

After a 12% decrease, the new price will be Rs. 0.88x per kg.

The amount of sugar bought before the price decrease = 1200 / x kg.

The amount of sugar bought after the price decrease = 1200 / (0.88x) kg.

⇒ 1200 / (0.88x) = 1200 / x + 7
